name: autonomous-ux-eval
description: Autonomous UX Evaluation SaaS — monorepo for web app and AI agent worker

scripts.build: npm run build -w @autonomous-ux/database && npm run build -w @autonomous-ux/web && npm run build -w @autonomous-ux/worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @autonomous-ux/database && npm run lint -w @autonomous-ux/web && npm run lint -w @autonomous-ux/worker
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @autonomous-ux/database && npm run typecheck -w @autonomous-ux/web && npm run typecheck -w @autonomous-ux/worker
scripts.postinstall: npm run db:generate && npm run build:db
